pages.text: Earth has been knocked out of orbit into deep space. The sun shrinks and the cold deepens: the $(bold)Frozen Dawn$().$(br2)This manual keeps you alive.$(br2)$(flavor)The bar is low and you cleared it.$()

pages.title: Key Rules
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Go underground.$() Below Y=0 is warmest.$(li)$(bold)Heat early.$() Heaters before Phase 3.$(li)$(bold)Stockpile fuel.$() Surface coal freezes in Phase 4.$(li)$(bold)Seal a room$() before late Phase 6.

pages.title: Late Phase 6
pages.text: $(danger)The surface becomes vacuum.$() A roof won't save you. You need trapped air, or Core or Blast Pit oxygen in a sealed room.$(br2)See $(l:heating/atmospheric_breach)Room Breaches$(/l).

pages.title: Where to Start
pages.text: Deep ground cools slowest. A sealed, insulated base saves fuel.$(br2)Read $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l), then $(l:heating/room_climate)Insulation$(/l).
